name: Aven Mimeomancer
oracle_text:
Flying
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a feather counter on target creature. If you do, that creature has base power and toughness 3/1 and has flying for as long as it has a feather counter on it.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a feather counter on target creature. If you do, that creature has base power and toughness 3/1 and has flying for as long as it has a feather counter on it.

needs.what: a `duration: "while_counter"` (with `counter` naming the kind, here "feather") on the ops that set base power/toughness and grant keywords -- `animate` with `keep_colors`/no type change setting base 3/1 and `keywords: ["flying"]` (or `set_pt` plus `grant_keyword`) -- so the effect lasts exactly as long as the target has a counter of that kind, ending when the last one is removed, with no end-of-turn clock
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_subtype` is the only op with a `while_counter` duration (Xolatoyac's flood counter). `animate` accepts only until-end-of-turn, until-your-next-turn or `permanent`; `grant_keyword` accepts until-end-of-turn, `permanent` or `as_long_as_you_control_source`; `set_pt` is an until-end-of-turn compensating pump. A `permanent` duration would keep the 3/1 flying body after the feather counter is removed, which is a different card
